title: XO Festival - Rotary Knob as Slider Control

affordance_translation.physical_behavior: A hi-fi / mixer potentiometer knob: rotate around a fixed axis, detents or tick marks indicate value, rotation angle maps to level.
affordance_translation.digital_mechanic: A flat-design knob element replaces a conventional slider: drag (or scroll) rotates the knob through a 270-degree travel arc and sets the underlying value; rotation angle is the data.

design_tokens.borders: Flat circular knob silhouette with a single indicator line from center to edge; clean vector edges, no bevels
design_tokens.elevation: Completely flat; depth suggested only by the knob's tick arc
design_tokens.typography: Geometric sans-serif festival type; value readouts set near the knob like equipment legends

interactive_mechanics: Drag vertically/rotationally to spin the knob and update the slider value
Arc/tick marks show travel range and current position
Touch and pointer supported as one continuous rotational gesture
usability_notes: A knob suits music/audio festival brands where the metaphor IS the product domain, but it is objectively worse than a slider for precise input (NN/g: precise value entry via rotary control needs high motor skill). Provide an accompanying numeric readout and a plain slider fallback; keep knob for low-precision, fun-only controls. Awwwards Honorable Mention (Gewest13, 2017).
